description:
Seeking UX/UI Designer for Mobile App Onboarding Experience


Join us on our journey to revolutionize the way people capture and share events and special happenings. We're dedicated to creating an app that's not just functional but essential for documenting life's adventures.


Project Scope:

Redesign the Onboarding Flow: Your main task is to make the app's introduction as inviting and informative as possible. We want our users to understand the app’s purpose right away and feel motivated to dive right in.


Profile Creation Optimization: Direct users smoothly to complete their profile setup — a crucial step for personalizing their experience.


Engagement through Direct Actions: Design prompts that encourage users to upload their first event photo, making the app immediately useful and engaging.


Intuitive Navigation to Core Features: Ensure users are well-guided towards adding and exploring photos on the map, understanding the app's core value proposition without feeling overwhelmed.


Alternative Engagement Pathways: Offer pathways for users who might skip initial content creation, enticing them to explore and interact with existing content.


Responsibilities:

Craft a compelling onboarding experience that highlights the app's unique features.


Employ clear, engaging UX copy that communicates the app's value and instructions succinctly.


Prototype and iterate onboarding flows based on user feedback and analytics.


Provide strategic design insights based on user research, trends, and best practices.


Requirements:

Strong portfolio in UX/UI design, showcasing successful mobile app projects.

Expertise in design and prototyping in Figma.

Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Creative problem-solving approach and a keen eye for detail.

Passionate about creating intuitive user experiences.


Application Process:

Please submit a brief cover letter explaining your interest and fit for the role and a link to your portfolio showcasing relevant work. Highlight any previous experience with onboarding flows and mobile app design.

Web UI Designer to design a converting online shop for digital products

Posted 11 hours ago


Worldwide

We are looking for a talented and experienced UI/UX Designer to lead the redesign of our small existing online shop, which specializes in digital gaming products. The ideal candidate will bring a fresh perspective and innovative ideas to enhance the user experience and visual appeal of our platform across both mobile and desktop versions. - Proficiency in design tools such as Sketch, Figma, or similar.

- Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and deliver high-quality work within deadlines.


This freelance position offers the opportunity to significantly impact the success and growth of our online game shop. If you are passionate about creating user-centered designs and have a love for games, we would love to hear from you.

Job Description:


We are seeking a creative and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing and shaping unique, user-centric products and experiences. -Collaboration: Work closely with developers to ensure accurate implementation of designs. Provide clear design specifications and support during the development process.

-User-Centered Design: Create user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for web and mobile applications.

-Research and Testing: Conduct user research and evaluate user feedback to gather insights and validate designs. Utilize data and analytics to inform design decisions.

-Brand Consistency: Ensure the design is consistent with the brand while also meeting usability and website standards.

-Revisions and Updates: Iterate designs based on user feedback, technical constraints, and market dynamics.

-Documentation: Document design processes, guidelines, and standards.


Requirements:

We are seeking a highly skilled Figma expert to join our team. The ideal candidate should have a minimum of 5 years of experience in Figma design and prototyping. -Maintain consistency and best practices across all design assets.

-Stay up-to-date with the latest design trends, tools, and techniques.

-Minimum of 5 years of experience working with Figma.

Strong portfolio showcasing your UI/UX design, wireframing, and prototyping expertise.

-Excellent understanding of design principles, typography, and color theory.

-Proficiency in creating interactive prototypes and animations within Figma.

-Ability to collaborate effectively with team members and communicate design concepts.

-Attention to detail and a passion for creating exceptional user experiences.

-Experience working in a fast-paced environment and meeting tight deadlines.

-Strong problem-solving skills and ability to think creatively.

Please provide your Upwork profile or portfolio demonstrating your Figma expertise and examples of your past work. Only candidates with at least 5 years of experience in Figma and a strong portfolio will be considered.


We look forward to reviewing your applications and finding the perfect candidate to join our team!


Thank you.

description:
Shopify Developer Needed for Single-Product E-commerce Website


Project Description:

We are an emerging brand in the Consumer Drone space, poised to launch our flagship product. Our product provides a solution for drone enthusiasts seeking to utilize their drone in challenging area’s. Once hired I will provide product images that I would like to use on the website. We seek a Shopify expert to create an e-commerce that highlights the product and solution it provides.


The Role:

You will be tasked with developing our Shopify e-commerce site from the ground up. The website will be dedicated exclusively to selling our single product, so the design should be minimalistic yet captivating, ensuring a seamless and engaging shopping experience for our customers.


Key Responsibilities:

- Design Customization: Craft a visually appealing Shopify page that aligns with our product's aesthetic and our brand's identity. The design should be clean, user-friendly, and optimized for conversions.

- Shopify Setup and Configuration: Handle all aspects of setting up the e-commerce platform, including payment gateways, shipping, taxes, and necessary apps or plugins.

- Product Presentation: Create an intuitive product page that showcases the product's features through high-quality images, compelling descriptions, and engaging multimedia (videos, animations, etc.).

- SEO and Mobile Optimization: Ensure the site is optimized for search engines and fully responsive, providing a seamless shopping experience on both desktop and mobile devices.

Testing and Launch: Conduct thorough testing of the website to ensure functionality, speed, and security are up to par. Assist with the site launch and provide guidelines for managing orders and content.


Ideal Candidate:

- Proven experience in Shopify store development, particularly with single-product sites.

- Strong portfolio showcasing previous e-commerce projects, with an emphasis on design aesthetics.

- Expertise in responsive web design, SEO principles, and conversion rate optimization.

- Ability to work efficiently under tight deadlines and communicate effectively throughout the project.


Project Duration:

Looking to be completed within 3-4 weeks from project start date, but please provide your timeline in your proposal


Budget:

dependent on experience and portfolio quality. Please provide your quote along with your application.


Application Requirements:

- Brief cover letter explaining why you are the perfect fit for this project.

- Portfolio of relevant Shopify e-commerce sites you've developed.

- Estimated timeline and quote for the project completion.

Any questions you have about the product or the project.


Let's create a website that perfectly encapsulates the essence of our product and offers our customers a memorable shopping experience. If you're passionate about building beautiful, effective e-commerce sites and are excited about working with innovative products, we'd love to hear from you!

Description:

We are seeking an experienced Shopify developer to create a dynamic e-commerce website for our used guitar business. The website should seamlessly integrate with eBay, Reverb, for efficient cross-posting of our guitar inventory. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Shopify's capabilities and API integrations, as well as experience with third-party API platforms like eBay and Reverb.


Responsibilities:


Develop a customized Shopify website tailored to our guitar business needs.

Implement seamless integration with eBay and Reverb (additional integration with Facebook marketplace, Craigslist, and OfferUp would be a huge plus) facilitate cross-posting / delisting of our guitar inventory.

Ensure the website is user-friendly, mobile-responsive, and optimized for SEO.

Provide ongoing support (can be paid on retainer monthly after website is functioning) and maintenance to troubleshoot any issues and implement updates as needed.

Collaborate with our team to implement any additional features or functionalities as required.



Requirements:


Proven experience as a Shopify developer with a portfolio of successful e-commerce website projects.

Expertise in Shopify's platform, including theme customization, app integration, and API development.

Experience with integrating Shopify with third-party platforms such as eBay, Reverb ( Facebook Marketplace, Craigslist, OfferUp API a huge plus).

Strong understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other relevant web technologies.

Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with our team.

Attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work within deadlines.

If you have the skills and experience required to create a seamless Shopify website integrated with multiple platforms, we'd love to hear from you. Please include examples of your previous Shopify projects and any relevant experience with cross-platform integrations in your proposal.

description:
X Website Designer/Developer (Luxury Watch E-commerce, SEO, Conversion Optimization)


We are seeking a talented UX Website Designer/Developer with expertise in luxury watch e-commerce, SEO, and conversion optimization to join our team.



The ideal candidate will be responsible for crafting visually stunning, user-friendly, and SEO-optimized websites that elevate our brand, engage our audience, and drive conversions in the luxury watch market.


Responsibilities:


Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand the unique requirements and aesthetics of the luxury watch industry and translate them into captivating website designs.


Design and develop responsive e-commerce websites that reflect the sophistication, elegance, and exclusivity of luxury watch brands.

Implement advanced SEO strategies tailored to the luxury watch market to enhance online visibility, attract high-quality traffic, and increase organic search rankings.


Conduct comprehensive keyword research, on-page optimization, and content refinement to optimize website performance and relevance for luxury watch enthusiasts.


Execute A/B testing, user feedback analysis, and conversion rate optimization (CRO) to identify opportunities for enhancing website usability, driving engagement, and maximizing sales.

Stay abreast of industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in UX design, web development, luxury e-commerce, and high-end watches.


Collaborate closely with marketing teams to create compelling product showcases, editorial content, and immersive brand experiences that resonate with luxury watch buyers and sellers.

Monitor website analytics, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and generate insightful reports to evaluate the effectiveness of website designs and optimization initiatives.


Provide ongoing maintenance, support, and troubleshooting for existing websites, ensuring seamless functionality, performance, and user satisfaction.

We are on the lookout for a skilled Shopify Developer/frontend developer

• Integrate quick fixes and new features into our Shopify sites.

• Strong problem-solving skills and meticulous attention to detail.

• Excellent communication and team collaboration abilities.

• Have experience using Github

• Must be able to participate in a weekly touch base google Meeting to review tasks and progress

• Must be able to communicate fluently in English

So the H1 is the product sheet title

And the H2 must be the titles separated by :: (product tab title)

Experienced UX/UI ecommerce designer needed for figma site redesign


Hello,


We are looking for an experienced ecommerce designer to create a redesign of our website in figma.


Our current site works well, but we are looking to refresh the site with an updated style. We have references to other websites that we like to use as inspiration, which we will provide during the project (if you wish to see prior to bidding, please ask in DM and I will share details of some reference sites we like).


Our site is built on woocommerce, so this will need to be considered during the figma design process so it's ready for our developers.

UI/UX Designer Needed


UI/UX Designer responsibilities include gathering and evaluating client design task requirements, designing graphic elements, web pages and sites, presentations, social media graphics and/or infographics, etc. To be successful in this role, you should have experience with current design software and wireframe tools. At LinkGraph, we present and edit all design projects in Figma. We also operate in a fast-paced environment and would need the right candidate to provide high-quality designs with quick and responsive turnaround times. 


This is a part-time role. The perfect person would be flexible - some weeks we may have a lot of hours, and some weeks none at all. 



Responsibilities:

- Gather and evaluate client tasks and design task instructions in collaboration with the project manager.

- Illustrate design ideas using Figma

- Develop UI mockups and prototypes that clearly illustrate how sites function and look like

- Conduct layout and design adjustments based on client and manager feedback

- Adhere to style standards on fonts, colors and images


Requirements and skills:

- Proven work experience as a UI/UX Designer 

- Portfolio of design projects

- Knowledge of wireframe tools (e.g. Figma)

- Up-to-date knowledge of design software like Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

- Strong and responsive communication skills

- Good time-management skills and the ability to provide quick turnaround times with designs and revisions



Ultimately, you’ll create both functional and appealing designs that address our clients’ needs and help us grow our customer base. If you have a portfolio of professional design projects that includes high-quality work with web and mobile applications, we would like to meet you!


You will be asked to answer the following questions when submitting a proposal:

  1. Please describe your past UI/UX experience.
  2. Please link to your portfolio or provide some samples :)

description:
E-commerce Developer


About Us:

Underground Surf is a dynamic and growing e-commerce company specializing in Surf, Skate and Foil Surf products. We are dedicated to providing our customers with an exceptional online shopping experience and innovative solutions to meet their needs. As we continue to expand our online presence, we're seeking a talented E-commerce Developer to help us in our planned developments.


Position Overview:

We are looking for a skilled and experienced E-commerce Developer to implement the development and maintenance of the extension of our e-commerce website. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in web development, with expertise in e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, BigCommerce, or other CMS. The E-commerce Developer will be responsible for implementing new features, utilizing some of the AI plugins available today, optimizing website performance, and ensuring a seamless shopping experience for our customers.


Responsibilities:

1. Customize and extend e-commerce platform functionality to meet the needs of our business and improve the user experience.


2. Implement and maintain integrations with third-party tools and services, such as payment gateways, shipping providers, and marketing automation platforms.


3. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product management, to implement new features and enhancements.


Qualifications:


1. At least 3 years of experience as an E-commerce Developer or similar role, with a proven track record of successfully developing and maintaining e-commerce websites.


2. Strong understanding of web development principles, including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and responsive design.


3. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


How to Apply:

If you are solution orientated and a motivated E-commerce Developer looking for an exciting opportunity to contribute to a growing company, we want to hear from you! Please get in touch with us with your portfolio (links to your work) showcasing your relevant experience and projects.

description:
1. Introduction - 3 hours

  • What is Vue.js? - 1 hour
  • Why use Vue.js? - 1 hour
  • Comparison with other frameworks - 1 hour

2. Setting Up - 3 hours

  • Including Vue via CDN - 0.5 hour
  • Setting up with Vue CLI - 1.5 hours
  • Vue project structure - 1 hour

3. Core Concepts - 4 hours

  • The Vue instance - 1 hour
  • Data-driven components - 1.5 hours
  • The Vue lifecycle - 1.5 hours

4. Template Syntax - 5 hours

  • Interpolation - 1 hour
  • Directives - 2 hours
  • Shorthands - 0.5 hour
  • Filters - 1.5 hours

5. Components - 6 hours

  • Component Anatomy - 1 hour
  • Component props - 1 hour
  • Custom events - 1 hour
  • Slots - 1 hour
  • Component registration - 1 hour
  • Component Lifecycle Hooks - 1 hour

6. Computed Properties and Watchers - 4 hours

  • Difference between computed and methods - 1 hour
  • Creating reactive computed properties - 1.5 hours
  • Watchers - 1.5 hours

7. Reactivity in Depth - 4 hours

  • Vue's reactive data - 1.5 hours
  • The virtual DOM - 1.5 hours
  • Reactivity caveats - 1 hour

8. Routing with Vue Router - 5 hours

  • Basic routing - 1 hour
  • Named routes and views - 1.5 hours
  • Route parameters - 1 hour
  • Navigation guards - 1.5 hours

9. State Management with Vuex - 7 hours

  • Understanding state - 2 hours
  • Actions, Mutations, and Getters - 3 hours
  • Modules in Vuex - 2 hours

10. Mixins and Custom Directives - 3 hours

  • Creating reusable mixins - 1.5 hours
  • Custom directive creation - 1.5 hours

11. Transitions & Animation - 4 hours

  • Transition classes - 1 hour
  • JavaScript hooks - 1 hour
  • Animate.css integration - 1 hour
  • Transitioning between components - 1 hour

12. Form Handling - 4 hours

  • Binding to inputs - 1 hour
  • Form validation - 1.5 hours
  • Handling various form controls - 1.5 hours

13. Communicating with a Server - 5 hours

  • Making HTTP requests - 2 hours
  • Handling CORS - 0.5 hour
  • Fetching and displaying data - 2.5 hours

14. Advanced Component Patterns - 5 hours

  • Render functions - 1.5 hours
  • Functional components - 1.5 hours
  • Scoped slots - 2 hours

15. Plugins and Tooling - 4 hours

  • Using plugins - 1 hour
  • Creating custom plugins - 1.5 hours
  • Vue devtools - 1.5 hours

16. Testing - 8 hours

  • Unit testing with Jest - 3 hours
  • Component testing with Vue Test Utils - 3 hours
  • End-to-end testing with Cypress - 2 hours

17. Deployment and Optimization - 5 hours

  • Build process - 2 hours
  • Lazy loading - 1.5 hours
  • SEO considerations - 1.5 hours

18. Next Steps: Advanced Vue - 7 hours

  • The Composition API - 2.5 hours
  • Server-side rendering with Nuxt.js - 2.5 hours
  • Mobile development with Vue Native - 2 hours

19. Community and Resources - 3 hours

  • Vue community and ecosystem - 1 hour
  • Key Vue conferences and events - 1 hour
  • Recommended reading and online resources - 1 hour

Remember, these are rough estimates, and the actual time spent can vary based on factors like individual pace, prior experience, and depth of exploration. Always ensure to couple theoretical learning with practical exercises to reinforce understanding.

description:
Estimated Time (12hrs)


Practice is compulsory for every topic and creates a separate file for each topic


3.1 Introduction to JavaScript Objects (2hrs 30mins)

Topics:

  • Objects and Object Literals: Understanding objects and how to create them using object literals.
  • Properties and Methods: Adding, accessing, and removing properties; defining methods.
  • Constructor functions
  • Prototypes
  • The "this" Keyword: Understanding the context of this in different scenarios.

Follow the below link to learn more:

  • MDN - Working with objects - https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Guide/Working_with_Objects
  • Properties - https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_object_properties.asp
  • Methods - https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_object_methods.asp
  • Constructor functions - https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_object_constructors.asp
  • Prototypes - https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_object_prototypes.asp
  • Understanding the "this" keyword - https://javascript.info/object-methods#the-this-keyword


3.2: Introduction to Arrays (7hrs)

Topics:

  • Declaration and Initialization: Different ways to declare and initialize arrays.
  • Basic Array Operations: Accessing elements, length property.
  • Array Methods: In-depth look at methods like map, filter, and reduce.
  • Chaining Array Methods: Combining methods for powerful data processing.
  • Mutability vs Immutability in JavaScript

Follow the below link to learn more:

  • MDN - Array - https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Array
  • JavaScript.info - Array Methods - https://javascript.info/array-methods
  • W3 - Array Methods - https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_array_methods.asp
  • Chaining Array methods - https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/chaining-of-array-methods-in-javascript/
  • Mutability vs Immutability in JavaScript - https://www.codementor.io/@manik488/mutability-vs-immutability-in-javascript-1g9hwoeddd


3.3: JSON in JavaScript (2hrs 30mins)

Topics:

  • JSON Syntax and Structure: Basics of JSON format.
  • Working with JSON: Parsing and stringifying, working with JSON in JavaScript.

Follow the below link to learn more:

  • MDN - JSON - https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/JSON
  • Working with JSON - Eloquent JavaScript - https://eloquentjavascript.net/20_node.html

rawDescription: Estimated Time (05 hrs)Every topic in practice is compulsory and create a separate file for every practice8.1 Date (3hr)- JavaScript simplifies date and time manipulation through the Date object, a versatile tool for managing temporal information in web applications.		8.1.1 Date Object: (15 min)		- The Date object represents a date and time in JavaScript. You can create a new date object using the new Date() constructor.		Follow the below link for learn more.https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Datehttps://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asphttps://javascript.info/date		8.1.2 Get Date Functions: (45 min)		- The Date object has methods to retrieve various aspects of the date and time.getFullYear(): Returns the year.getMonth(): Returns the month (0-11).getDate(): Returns the day of the month.getHours(): Returns the hour.getMinutes(): Returns the minutes.getSeconds(): Returns the seconds.		Follow the below link for learn more.https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Datehttps://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asphttps://javascript.info/date		8.1.3 Set Date Function: (45 min)		- The Date object also has methods to set various components of the date and time.setFullYear(year): Sets the year.setMonth(month): Sets the month (0-11).setDate(day): Sets the day of the month.setHours(hours): Sets the hour.setMinutes(minutes): Sets the minutes.setSeconds(seconds): Sets the seconds.		Follow the below link for learn more.https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Datehttps://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asphttps://javascript.info/date		8.1.4 Formatting Dates: (45 min)		- Formatting dates in JavaScript often involves constructing a string with the desired format. Libraries like moment.js or the built-in toLocaleString() method can be used for more 					     advanced formatting.		- Example using toLocaleString():-  let currentDate = new Date();     let formattedDate = currentDate.toLocaleString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' });   		     print the output in console.log(formattedDate ).		Follow the below link for learn more.https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Datehttps://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asphttps://javascript.info/date		8.1.5 Sorting Dates: (30 min)		- To sort an array of dates, you can use the sort() method and provide a custom comparison function.		- Example:- let dateArray = [new Date('2023-01-01'), new Date('2022-12-31'), new Date('2023-02-01')];  dateArray.sort((a, b) => b - a);   print the output in console.log(dateArray )		Follow the below link for learn more.https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Datehttps://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asphttps://javascript.info/date8.2 Debugging (1hr)- Debugging in JavaScript refers to the process of identifying and fixing errors or bugs in your code. It's an essential skill for developers to ensure their programs run smoothly and produce 		 the expected results. JavaScript provides several tools and techniques for debugging, including:- Console Logging: Placing console.log() statements at strategic points in your code allows you to print values and messages to the browser console, helping you understand the flow of your program and identify issues.- Debugger Statement: Placing the debugger; statement in your code will pause execution at that point if the browser's developer tools are open, allowing you to interactively inspect the state of your application.- Exception Handling: Using try, catch, and throw statements allows you to handle exceptions gracefully and provides an opportunity to log or debug errors without crashing your entire application.- Linting Tools: Tools like ESLint can help you identify and fix common coding errors and style issues, promoting clean and error-free code.Follow the below link for learn more.https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_debugging.asphttps://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/console8.4 LocalStorage & Session Storage (1hr)- localStorage: localStorage is a type of web storage that persists even when the browser is closed and reopened. description:
Estimated Time (05 hrs)


Every topic in practice is compulsory and create a separate file for every practice


8.1 Date (3hr)

- JavaScript simplifies date and time manipulation through the Date object, a versatile tool for managing temporal information in web applications.


8.1.1 Date Object: (15 min)

- The Date object represents a date and time in JavaScript. You can create a new date object using the new Date() constructor.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.2 Get Date Functions: (45 min)

- The Date object has methods to retrieve various aspects of the date and time.

  • getFullYear(): Returns the year.
  • getMonth(): Returns the month (0-11).
  • getDate(): Returns the day of the month.
  • getHours(): Returns the hour.
  • getMinutes(): Returns the minutes.
  • getSeconds(): Returns the seconds.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.3 Set Date Function: (45 min)

- The Date object also has methods to set various components of the date and time.

  • setFullYear(year): Sets the year.
  • setMonth(month): Sets the month (0-11).
  • setDate(day): Sets the day of the month.
  • setHours(hours): Sets the hour.
  • setMinutes(minutes): Sets the minutes.
  • setSeconds(seconds): Sets the seconds.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date



8.1.4 Formatting Dates: (45 min)

- Formatting dates in JavaScript often involves constructing a string with the desired format. Libraries like moment.js or the built-in toLocaleString() method can be used for more advanced formatting.


- Example using toLocaleString():- let currentDate = new Date(); let formattedDate = currentDate.toLocaleString('en-US', { weekday: 'long', year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' }); print the output in console.log(formattedDate ).


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date


8.1.5 Sorting Dates: (30 min)

- To sort an array of dates, you can use the sort() method and provide a custom comparison function.


- Example:- let dateArray = [new Date('2023-01-01'), new Date('2022-12-31'), new Date('2023-02-01')]; dateArray.sort((a, b) => b - a); print the output in console.log(dateArray )


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Date
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_dates.asp
  • https://javascript.info/date



8.2 Debugging (1hr)

- Debugging in JavaScript refers to the process of identifying and fixing errors or bugs in your code. It's an essential skill for developers to ensure their programs run smoothly and produce the expected results. JavaScript provides several tools and techniques for debugging, including:


- Console Logging: Placing console.log() statements at strategic points in your code allows you to print values and messages to the browser console, helping you understand the flow of your program and identify issues.

- Debugger Statement: Placing the debugger; statement in your code will pause execution at that point if the browser's developer tools are open, allowing you to interactively inspect the state of your application.

- Exception Handling: Using try, catch, and throw statements allows you to handle exceptions gracefully and provides an opportunity to log or debug errors without crashing your entire application.

- Linting Tools: Tools like ESLint can help you identify and fix common coding errors and style issues, promoting clean and error-free code.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_debugging.asp
  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/console


8.4 LocalStorage & Session Storage (1hr)

- localStorage: localStorage is a type of web storage that persists even when the browser is closed and reopened. Data stored in localStorage remains available until explicitly cleared by the user or the web application.

- sessionStorage: sessionStorage is similar to localStorage but has a shorter lifespan. Data stored in sessionStorage is accessible only for the duration of the page session. It gets cleared when the page is closed or the browser is restarted.


Follow the below link for learn more.

  • https://javascript.info/localstorage
  • https://www.w3schools.com/jsref/prop_win_localstorage.asp
  • https://www.w3schools.com/jsref/prop_win_sessionstorage.asp

Estimated Time (04hr 10min)


Practice is compulsory for every topic and creates a separate file for each topic



4.1 Functions basic (30min)

- In JavaScript, functions are reusable blocks of code that perform a specific task. They are defined using the function keyword, followed by a name and a set of parameters in parentheses. Functions can be invoked using the name followed by parentheses, and they can return a value using the return keyword. Functions facilitate modular and organized code by encapsulating logic into distinct units.


Follow the below link to learn more

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_functions.asp
  • https://www.javatpoint.com/javascript-function



4.2 if, else, and else if (01hr)

- In JavaScript, if statements are used for conditional execution, allowing you to control the flow of your code. If a specified condition evaluates to true, the code inside the if block is executed. The else statement provides an alternative block of code to execute when the if condition is false. Additionally, else if allows you to check multiple conditions sequentially, executing the corresponding block of code for the first true condition.


Follow the below link to learn more

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_if_else.asp
  • https://www.javatpoint.com/javascript-if



4.3 Switch Statement (40min)

- In JavaScript, the switch statement provides a way to execute different code blocks based on the value of an expression. It evaluates the expression against multiple case values and executes the block of code associated with the first matching case. The default case is optional and is executed if none of the cases match. The switch statement offers a more concise and readable alternative to multiple if-else statements when comparing a single value against multiple possibilities.


Follow the below link to learn more

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_switch.asp
  • https://www.javatpoint.com/javascript-switch



4.4 Loop (02hr)

- In JavaScript, loops are used to repeatedly execute a block of code. The for loop is a common construct with an initialization statement, a condition for continuation, and an increment/decrement statement. The while loop continues execution as long as a specified condition is true. The do-while loop is similar but ensures the block of code is executed at least once, as the condition is checked after the loop body. Loops provide a powerful mechanism for automating repetitive tasks in JavaScript programs.


Follow the below link to learn more

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_loop_for.asp

Estimated Time (10hrs)


Practice is compulsory for every topic and creates a separate file for each topic


7.1 Working with Callbacks (1hr 30mins)

Topics:

  • Callback Functions: Definition and Usage
  • Handling Errors in Callbacks
  • Callback Hell and Ways to Avoid It

Follow the below link to learn more:

  • Callback Hell - http://callbackhell.com/
  • MDN - Callback function - https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/Callback_function


7.2 Understanding Asynchronous JavaScript (1hr)

Topics:

  • Introduction to Asynchronous Programming
  • Synchronous vs. Asynchronous Code
  • Event Loop and Concurrency Model

Follow the below link to learn more:

  • MDN - Introducing asynchronous JavaScript - https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/JavaScript/Asynchronous/Introducing


7.3 Promises (3hrs 30mins)

Topics:

  • Introduction to Promises
  • Creating and Using Promises
  • Chaining Promises
  • Error Handling with Promises
  • Promise.all, Promise.race, Promise.allSettled
  • Best Practices with Promises

Follow the below link to learn more:

  • JavaScript Promises for Dummies - https://scotch.io/tutorials/javascript-promises-for-dummies
  • MDN - Using promises - https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Guide/Using_promises

  • MDN - Promise.race - https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Promise/race


7.4 Async/Await (4hrs)

Topics:

  • Async Functions and Await Operator
  • Error Handling in Async/Await
  • Using Async/Await with Promises
  • Working with APIs and Fetch
  • Timers and Asynchronous Callbacks
  • Handling Multiple Asynchronous Operations in Parallel

Follow the below link to learn more:

  • MDN - Making asynchronous programming easier with async and await - https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/JavaScript/Asynchronous/Async_await
  • JavaScript.info - Async/await - https://javascript.info/async-await
  • MDN - Using Fetch - https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Fetch_API/Using_Fetch

Freelance Website Designer: E-commerce Website Optimization (One-Time Project):


Are you a talented website designer with a knack for optimizing e-commerce platforms? We have an exciting one-time opportunity for you to lend your expertise and elevate our online store to new heights!


Responsibilities:


1. Website Assessment: Conduct a comprehensive evaluation of our current e-commerce website, identifying areas for improvement in design, navigation, and user experience.


2. Design Optimization: Collaborate with our team to develop design solutions that enhance the visual appeal and usability of the website, focusing on improving conversion rates and maximizing sales.


3. Navigation Enhancement: Streamline website navigation to improve user flow and facilitate seamless browsing and shopping experiences for our customers.


4. Mobile Responsiveness:Ensure that the website is fully responsive across all devices, optimizing for mobile users to enhance accessibility and engagement.


5. Page Speed Optimization: Implement strategies to improve website loading times and performance, enhancing user satisfaction and reducing bounce rates.


6. Visual Enhancements: Utilize your design expertise to create visually compelling product pages, category layouts, and promotional banners that effectively showcase our products.


7. Conversion Rate Optimization: Implement best practices for conversion rate optimization (CRO), including clear calls-to-action (CTAs) and persuasive product presentations to drive sales.


8. SEO Integration: Ensure that design changes align with search engine optimization (SEO) best practices, optimizing for visibility and ranking in search engine results pages (SERPs).


Requirements:


- Proven experience as a website designer with a portfolio showcasing successful e-commerce projects.

- Proficiency in design tools such as Adobe Photoshop, Adobe XD, Sketch, or Figma.

- Strong understanding of UX/UI principles and best practices for e-commerce websites.

- Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for implementing design changes.

- Excellent communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively.


Benefits:


- Competitive compensation: Earn based on the scope and complexity of the project.

- Portfolio enhancement: Showcase your expertise in e-commerce website optimization through this impactful project.

- Flexibility: Work remotely and on your own schedule to deliver high-quality results within the agreed-upon timeframe.


If you're a skilled website designer ready to take on a rewarding one-time project, we want to hear from you! Please submit your portfolio along with a brief introduction highlighting your relevant experience and enthusiasm for e-commerce design.


*Note: This is a one-time freelance opportunity with potential for future collaboration on additional projects. Remote candidates are welcome to apply.*


Don't miss out on this chance to make a lasting impact on our e-commerce platform. Apply now and let's create success together!

5.1 Function (1hr 30min)

- In JavaScript, functions are reusable blocks of code that perform a specific task. They can take parameters as input, execute a series of statements, and return a value. Functions promote code modularity, enhancing readability and maintainability. Whether defined traditionally or as arrow functions, they play a central role in structuring and organizing JavaScript programs.

5.1.1 Declaration and invocation

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_function_parameters.asp
  • https://www.freecodecamp.org/news/what-is-the-difference-between-parameters-and-arguments-in-javascript/


5.1.3 Return values

Follow the below link to learn

  • https://www.w3schools.com/jsref/jsref_return.asp

5.1.4 Scope and closures

Follow the below link to learn

5.1.5 Arrow functions

Follow the below link to learn

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_arrow_function.asp
  • https://www.geeksforgeeks.org/arrow-functions-in-javascript/



5.2 JavaScript Math Functions (1hr)

- JavaScript provides a set of built-in Math functions for common mathematical operations. These functions include Math.round() for rounding to the nearest integer, Math.random() for generating pseudo-random numbers, Math.floor() for rounding down, and Math.sqrt() for calculating the square root. Leveraging these functions simplifies complex mathematical tasks and enhances precision in JavaScript applications.


Follow the below link to learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_math.asp
  • https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/Math



5.3 String Search Methods (2hr 30min)

- In JavaScript, string search methods help find and manipulate substrings within a string. The indexOf method returns the index of the first occurrence of a specified substring, while lastIndexOf does the same from the end of the string. The includes method checks if a string contains a particular substring, returning a boolean. These methods offer efficient ways to locate and work with specific content within strings in JavaScript


Follow the below link to learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_string_search.asp
  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_string_methods.asp



5.4 Strict Mode (30min)

- Strict Mode in JavaScript is a set of rules that enhances error handling and makes code more robust. Activated by adding the directive "use strict"; at the beginning of a script or a function, it catches common coding mistakes, prevents the use of certain error-prone features, and promotes safer coding practices. Strict Mode helps developers write cleaner and more reliable code by flagging and preventing potentially problematic behaviors in JavaScript programs.


Follow the below link to learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_strict.asp
  • https://www.javatpoint.com/javascript-strict-mode



5.5 Regular Expressions (01hr)

- In JavaScript, regular expressions (RegEx) are powerful tools for pattern matching within strings. They provide a concise and flexible syntax to define search patterns, allowing for tasks like validation, extraction, and manipulation of text. JavaScript supports RegEx through the RegExp object and provides methods like test and exec for matching and extracting patterns from strings. Regular expressions are invaluable for tasks involving complex string manipulation and validation in JavaScript.


Follow the below link to learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_regexp.asp



5.6 Loop (01hr)

- In JavaScript, classes are a way to define blueprints for creating objects with shared properties and methods. Introduced in ECMAScript 2015 (ES6), they provide a more structured and object-oriented approach to programming. Class instances are created using the new keyword, and inheritance is facilitated through the use of extends. Classes enhance code organization and readability, offering a modern syntax for implementing object-oriented principles in JavaScript.


Follow the below link to learn more.

  • https://www.w3schools.com/js/js_classes.asp

description:
Expert Designer needed for design improvements and clickable prototype for fitness app


We are in search of a proficient UX Designer to join our project team on finishing our high fidelity design and creating a Figma clickable prototype. The primary aim of this project is to refine our app to ensure an intuitive, seamless, and user-centric experience.


Project Milestones:

1. Implementation of Design Enhancements (Milestone 1):

• Refine the existing high-fidelity designs by incorporating the agreed-upon enhancements, aiming for a balance between visual appeal and functional usability.

• Engage in iterative feedback with the project team to fine-tune these enhancements, ensuring alignment with the overall vision and user needs.

2. Clickable Prototype Development and Testing Prep (Milestone 2):

• Convert the enhanced high-fidelity designs into a fully interactive clickable prototype using Figma, simulating realistic user interactions for testing purposes.

• Ensure the prototype is prepared for user testing, emphasizing ease of navigation and the overall user engagement experience.


Budget:


Our project is budgeted at $1,000, divided across the milestones as follows:


• Milestone 1: Implementation of Design Enhancements - $300

• Milestone 1: Clickable Prototype Development - $700


Requirements:


• Demonstrated expertise in UX Design, with a portfolio showcasing successful design evaluations, enhancements, and clickable prototype developments.

• Advanced proficiency in Figma for both design refinement and prototype creation.

• Solid understanding of user-centered design principles, applied to improve app usability and design.

• Strong communication skills for effective collaboration and feedback integration.

• Detail-oriented approach with a commitment to creating exceptional user experiences.


Agreement to sign an NDA is required. No cover letter needed.


You will be asked to answer the following questions when submitting a proposal:

  1. Provide 2 examples of clickable prototypes you made in figma for a mobile app.
  2. Please provide examples of high fidelity mobile app designs made in Figma.

description:
Website for a gym on Shopify

Posted 5 hours ago


Worldwide

Project Overview:


We are seeking for someone to create a dynamic and user-friendly website for our gym on Shopify. The website should serve as a comprehensive digital platform that showcases our fitness programs, facilities, and unique gym culture. Our goal is to attract new members while providing existing members with an easy way to access gym information, class schedules, and online booking options.


Key Deliverables:


Homepage: A visually appealing landing page that encapsulates our gym's brand and ethos, with clear navigation to different sections of the site.


About Us Page: Details about our gym's history, mission, and team.


Programs and Classes: A detailed overview of the fitness programs and classes we offer, including schedules and the ability to book classes online.


Membership Information: Information on membership options, benefits, and an online sign-up feature.


Contact Us Page: A form for inquiries as well as our contact details and location map.


Mobile Responsiveness: The website must be fully optimized for mobile devices.

15.1 Pattern matching and manipulation (2.5 hours)

16.1 Basic usage of version control systems like Git (2.5 hours)


17 Testing:

17.1 Writing and running tests for your PHP code (2 hours)


18 Composer:

18.1 Dependency management for PHP (2 hours)


19 Debugging:

19.1 Using debugging tools and techniques (30 minutes)


20 Best Practices:

20.1 Following coding standards (30 minutes)

20.2 Writing clean and maintainable code (30 minutes)


21 Final PHP practical test: (2.5 hours)

Talented UX/UI Designer Needed to Create a Brand Book and Ongoing Design Work


Job Description:

We're on the hunt for a skilled UX/UI Designer with a keen eye for detail and a passion for branding to create a comprehensive brand book based on our existing logo. This project is the beginning of an exciting journey, as we'll require continuous design support for various projects down the road. If you love bringing brands to life and are looking for an ongoing creative partnership, we'd love to hear from you!


Responsibilities:

Develop a detailed brand book that includes guidelines on logo usage, color palette, typography, imagery, and other visual elements.


Collaborate closely with our team to understand our brand’s essence and translate it into visual design.


Deliver high-quality, cohesive designs that reflect our brand identity.


Provide creative input and suggest improvements to enhance brand consistency across all platforms.


Be available for ongoing design projects, including digital assets, marketing materials, and product design updates.


Requirements:

Proven experience as a UX/UI Designer or similar role with a strong portfolio showcasing branding projects.


Excellent understanding of branding principles and design aesthetics.


Proficiency in design software (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, Figma).


Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.


Strong communication skills and ability to work collaboratively with remote teams.


Creative thinker with attention to detail and a passion for innovation.


What We Offer:

The opportunity to be part of a dynamic project with continuous creative challenges.


A collaborative and supportive work environment.


Flexibility and freedom to express your creative ideas.


Competitive compensation with the potential for long-term collaboration.


If you're excited about defining and expanding a brand's visual identity and are ready for a project with the potential for ongoing work, please submit your application with your portfolio, resume, and a brief cover letter explaining why you're the perfect fit for this role.

description:
Shopify Store expert


Job Title: Shopify Business Development Specialist

Job Overview:

We're seeking an experienced Shopify Business Development Specialist to join our team on a project basis. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in e-commerce, specifically with Shopify stores, and a proven track record in market research, supplier coordination, and product branding. Your role will be pivotal in launching a new Shopify business from the ground up, focusing on identifying profitable products, establishing drop shipping arrangements, creating compelling ad copy, and ensuring the overall market viability of our new venture.


Responsibilities:

Market Research: Conduct thorough market research to identify potential products, analyzing expected search volumes, competition, and profitability.

Supplier Coordination: Liaise with drop suppliers to order samples and negotiate terms to ensure product quality and viability before adding them to our store.

Ad Copy Creation: Craft compelling ad copy, product titles, and descriptions that resonate with our target audience and adhere to SEO best practices.

Custom Branding: Collaborate with our team to develop custom branding for selected products, enhancing our market presence and brand recognition.

Product Integration: Efficiently push approved and tested products to the store, ensuring a seamless integration with our Shopify platform.

Traffic Generation Plan: Develop and implement a robust plan to drive targeted traffic to our store, leveraging SEO, PPC, social media, and other relevant channels.

Requirements:

Proven experience in e-commerce, particularly with Shopify.

Strong background in market research, SEO, and e-commerce analytics.

Experience in working with drop shipping suppliers and order fulfillment processes.

Creative skills in writing ad copy and product descriptions.

Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced environment.

Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

Familiarity with branding and product customization processes.

How to Apply:

Please submit your application along with:


A brief cover letter explaining your interest in this position and your relevant experience.

Your resume or LinkedIn profile.

Portfolio of previous Shopify stores you have successfully launched or contributed to significantly.

Any case studies or results from past projects that demonstrate your ability to grow a Shopify business.

We are excited to hear from talented individuals who are passionate about e-commerce and have the skills to drive our new Shopify business to success. If you are ready to take on this challenge and contribute to our team, we look forward to reviewing your application.

description:
Long-Term UX/UI Designer for Jewelry E-Commerce Brand


SERASAR GmbH is a fast-growing eCommerce company poised to elevate the SERASAR brand to international acclaim within the fashion and jewellery industry. With our products showcased across various eCommerce marketplaces in Germany, Europe, the USA, and our own Shopify store, our ambition knows no bounds. As we set our sights on expanding the brand, broadening our product range, and venturing into new marketplaces, we are on the hunt for innovative talent to join us in realizing our vision.


We are excited to announce an opening for a UX/UI Designer - a pivotal role aimed at transforming the digital experience of our customers.


Your Role:

- Designing intuitive and visually appealing user interfaces for our Shopify store, ensuring a seamless shopping experience.

- Crafting engaging visuals for marketplace banners and icons, enhancing brand visibility and product appeal.

- Optimizing and refining product and influencer images, aligning them with our brand aesthetic.

- Creating compelling graphics for email marketing campaigns, driving engagement and conversions.

- Developing creative assets for social media posts and advertisements, bolstering our online presence and interaction.


Your Profile:

- Proven experience in UX/UI design, with a portfolio that showcases your skill in creating user-centric digital experiences.

- Expertise in design tools such as Adobe XD, Sketch, Figma, Photoshop, and Illustrator.

- A keen eye for design and aesthetics, with the ability to translate brand identity into engaging and functional designs.

- Excellent command of English (written and spoken), with German as a highly preferred second language. Fluency in French, Spanish, Italian, or Dutch is a plus but not mandatory.

- Strong organizational skills, with a structured approach to project management and the ability to meet deadlines.


Beyond Your Profile:

- Passion for UX/UI design, viewing it not just as a job but as a calling.

- Eager to learn and adapt, with a willingness to dive into new technologies and design trends.


What We Offer:

Join us, and together, we will craft a distinct brand identity encapsulated in a lookbook, setting the design standard for all future projects. This is a chance to be at the forefront of defining the digital face of an emerging world-renowned brand in the fashion and jewellery sector.


This position is designed for long-term collaboration, offering you the opportunity to grow alongside our brand and leave a lasting impact on our digital presence.

description:
Shopify UX/UI Designer & Web Developer


We are an SME specialising in cosmetic and health products, currently transitioning our e-commerce website from WordPress/WooCommerce to Shopify to improve user experience and to drive conversion. We are looking for a high performing, high converting, visually appealing site that aligns with our quality products and brand. We are seeking a highly skilled and versatile individual who can take on the combined role of a Shopify UX/UI Designer and Web Developer. This role is ideal for someone who has a strong understanding of e-commerce best practices, is proficient in both design and development within the Shopify ecosystem, and can seamlessly integrate user-centric design with functional development to create an exceptional online shopping experience.


Responsibilities:

Lead the design and development of our Shopify store, ensuring a seamless transition from WordPress / WooCommerce.

Conduct user research and competitor analysis to inform design decisions and optimise the customer journey and drive conversion while aligning with our brand.

Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs that are visually appealing and tailored to the Shopify platform.

Develop and customize Shopify themes to bring designs to life, ensuring cross-browser compatibility and mobile responsiveness.

Implement and configure Shopify apps to extend functionality and improve user experience.

Manage data migration from WooCommerce to Shopify, ensuring integrity and accuracy.

Optimize the site for search engines, speed, and performance within Shopify’s constraints.

Conduct thorough testing and provide ongoing support and enhancements post-launch.


Skills and Qualifications:

Proven experience in both UX/UI design and Shopify development, with a portfolio that demonstrates expertise in creating and implementing effective e-commerce solutions.

Strong proficiency in design tools (e.g., Adobe XD, Sketch, Figma) and a solid understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Liquid.

Knowledge of Shopify’s architecture, theme development, and app ecosystem.

Familiarity with responsive and adaptive design principles.

Excellent problem-solving skills, with a strong focus on delivering a user-friendly shopping experience.

Ability to work independently, manage multiple projects simultaneously, and meet deadlines.

Note: Given the dual nature of this role, candidates should be prepared to discuss their experience and approach to balancing design and development tasks, as well as their ability to stay up-to-date with the latest trends and technologies in both fields.

description:
Website and Shopify Store Development


We are seeking a talented and experienced web developer with expertise in both website development and Shopify store setup to join our team. As our ideal candidate, you will be responsible for creating a professional and visually appealing website tailored to our needs. This includes developing an intuitive and user-friendly interface for an ecommerce platform specializing in the sale of crypto-related ebooks, tutorials, and guides. Additionally, you will design and implement an Investors section on the website that seamlessly integrates information on AI, cryptocurrency, and esports to attract potential investors. Furthermore, you will incorporate features such as a Contact Us tab, allowing visitors to book a free 15-minute consultation with us, with the option to schedule paid appointments for more in-depth discussions. The successful candidate will possess strong technical skills, creativity, and a keen eye for detail to ensure the website meets our standards of excellence. If you are passionate about web development and interested in contributing to an innovative consulting company at the forefront of AI, cryptocurrency, and esports, we encourage you to apply:



- Web development (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)

- Shopify platform

- E-commerce website development

- Payment gateway integration

- User experience optimization

- Strong attention to detail and ability to meet deadlines.


If you have the skills and expertise needed for this project, we look forward to receiving your application.

description:
Solution for orders that have medium level fraud score

Orders can have 3 levels of fraud scoring. We have handled only two, not considering the middle score.


The extract program issues an api call for order risk. We are only processing orders where the response is accept. This corresponds to the Low value shown above. Any other risk response will be ignored. However, the Admin (Alex), may decide to process the Medium level orders after doing some background check and contacting the customer. We do not have logic currently that will allow us to handle these orders because the response is not accept.



Make Changes:


workflow - Alex will tag any order with the tag value “accepted” when he wishes to process an order whose original fraud score did not have the risk value of accept.

Code change: The extract program will process records that do not have the risk value of accept if and only if, the order also has the tag value of “accepted”



In order csv change price field by using a calculation that will include the discount amount


Our order CSV has the item price without discount. Alex has asked for us to include the discount amount. I am told that they are using this for monthly invoicing. We did not know this when we developed the app. This will probably require a calculation since the discounted price is not available as a field in the JSON file. 


Make Change In Price Calculation


Note, that the list price is $71 and there is a total discount amount of -$28.40 and there is a quantity of 2.

Currently we are putting 71 in the price field but what they need is to put the discounted unit price so….

(71 * 2) = 142. (line_items.price from api * line item quantity)

142 - 28.40 = 113.6 (sum of line_items.discount_allocations.amount from api)

113.6 / 2 = 56.8 (quantity from api)

Job Title: Shopify Website Developer with Subscription Integration


Job Description:


We are seeking a highly skilled Shopify Website Developer with expertise in creating subscription-based websites to build a digital access subscription platform. The primary focus of this role will be to design and develop a Shopify website that offers digital products available for download on a one-time use basis, utilizing a subscription model.


Key Responsibilities:


Design and develop a Shopify website with a digital access subscription plan, allowing customers to purchase subscriptions and gain credits for digital downloads.

Implement a subscription system where customers receive credits or points upon subscribing, with each credit equivalent to one digital download of a single product.

Integrate automatic subscription renewal functionality using Stripe or another payment processor to ensure seamless customer experience.

Create multiple landing pages to categorize and display groups of products. Approximately 10 groups of products will be featured, each containing between 20 and 100 individual products.

Ensure scalability of the website to accommodate future growth, allowing for easy addition of new products to each group.

Collaborate with the team to ensure all required files and pictures for each product are provided prior to website development.

Optimize website performance, user experience, and interface design for maximum customer satisfaction.

Adhere to project timelines and deliverables, aiming to complete the project within the specified 30-day timeframe.

Qualifications:


Proven experience in developing Shopify websites with subscription integration, preferably in a similar digital access subscription model.

Expertise in utilizing Shopify's platform and customization options to create tailored solutions for specific business requirements.

Strong proficiency in payment gateway integration, particularly with Stripe or similar payment processors.

Excellent understanding of web development technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Liquid.

Ability to organize and categorize products effectively, creating intuitive navigation and user-friendly interfaces.

Attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality, error-free work within tight deadlines.

Effective communication skills to collaborate with the team and provide updates on project progress.

Creative problem-solving abilities to address any challenges or obstacles encountered during website development.

If you possess the necessary skills and experience to undertake this exciting opportunity, we encourage you to apply and be part of our team.

1. Install Git: - 30 mins

  6. A Git repository is a folder where you'll store your code and its version history. Navigate to your project's folder in the terminal and run:
  7. Learn Git basics: - 2 hours
  8. Familiarize yourself with basic Git commands, such as:
  9. git clone: Copy a remote repository to your local machine.
  10. git add: Add changes to the staging area.
  11. git commit: Create a commit with the changes you've added to the staging area.
  12. git status: View the current status of your repository.
  13. git log: View the commit history.
  14. git pull: Fetch and integrate changes from a remote repository.
  15. git push: Upload your local commits to a remote repository.

description:
Windows:


  1. Download the installer: Go to the official Git website (https://git-scm.com/downloads) using your web browser.
  2. Select your download: Click on the "Windows" icon to download the installer for Windows.
  3. Run the installer: Once the download is complete, locate the downloaded file (usually named "Git-X.X.X-XXX.exe," where X.X.X-X is the version number) and double-click on it to start the installation process.
  4. Configure installation options:
  5. Select the components you want to install. The default selections are usually sufficient for most users.
  6. Choose the default text editor for Git (you can keep the default editor or choose your preferred one).
  7. Select the "Use Git from the Windows Command Prompt" option. This will enable you to use Git from the Command Prompt or PowerShell.
  8. Choose "Checkout Windows-style, commit Unix-style line endings" to ensure line endings compatibility across platforms.
  9. Choose the default branch name: Set your preferred default branch name. "master" is commonly used, but you can choose something else if you prefer.
  10. Choose the SSH executable: Unless you have specific requirements, it's generally fine to use the OpenSSH default.
  11. Complete the installation: Click "Install" to begin the installation process. Once it's completed, click "Next" and then "Finish" to exit the installer.
  12. Verify the installation: To check if Git is installed correctly, open a Command Prompt or PowerShell and run the following command:
git --version


macOS:

  • Homebrew (recommended):
  • If you have Homebrew installed on your macOS, open Terminal and run the following command:
brew install git
  • If Homebrew is not installed, you can install it first by following the instructions on the Homebrew website (https://brew.sh).
  • Verify the installation: To check if Git is installed correctly, open Terminal and run:
git --version

description:
Windows:


  1. Download the installer: Go to the official Git website (https://git-scm.com/downloads) using your web browser.
  2. Select your download: Click on the "Windows" icon to download the installer for Windows.
  3. Run the installer: Once the download is complete, locate the downloaded file (usually named "Git-X.X.X-XXX.exe," where X.X.X-X is the version number) and double-click on it to start the installation process.
  4. Configure installation options:
  5. Select the components you want to install. The default selections are usually sufficient for most users.
  6. Choose the default text editor for Git (you can keep the default editor or choose your preferred one).
  7. Select the "Use Git from the Windows Command Prompt" option. This will enable you to use Git from the Command Prompt or PowerShell.
  8. Choose "Checkout Windows-style, commit Unix-style line endings" to ensure line endings compatibility across platforms.
  9. Choose the default branch name: Set your preferred default branch name. "master" is commonly used, but you can choose something else if you prefer.
  10. Choose the SSH executable: Unless you have specific requirements, it's generally fine to use the OpenSSH default.
  11. Complete the installation: Click "Install" to begin the installation process. Once it's completed, click "Next" and then "Finish" to exit the installer.
  12. Verify the installation: To check if Git is installed correctly, open a Command Prompt or PowerShell and run the following command:
git --version


macOS:

  • Homebrew (recommended):
  • If you have Homebrew installed on your macOS, open Terminal and run the following command:
brew install git
  • If Homebrew is not installed, you can install it first by following the instructions on the Homebrew website (https://brew.sh).
  • Verify the installation: To check if Git is installed correctly, open Terminal and run:
git --version

  3. Run the installer: Once the download is complete, locate the downloaded file (usually named "Git-X.X.X-XXX.exe," where X.X.X-X is the version number) and double-click on it to start the installation process.
  4. Configure installation options:
  5. Select the components you want to install. The default selections are usually sufficient for most users.
  6. Choose the default text editor for Git (you can keep the default editor or choose your preferred one).
  7. Select the "Use Git from the Windows Command Prompt" option. This will enable you to use Git from the Command Prompt or PowerShell.
  8. Choose "Checkout Windows-style, commit Unix-style line endings" to ensure line endings compatibility across platforms.
  9. Choose the default branch name: Set your preferred default branch name. "master" is commonly used, but you can choose something else if you prefer.
  10. Choose the SSH executable: Unless you have specific requirements, it's generally fine to use the OpenSSH default.
  11. Complete the installation: Click "Install" to begin the installation process. Once it's completed, click "Next" and then "Finish" to exit the installer.
  12. Verify the installation: To check if Git is installed correctly, open a Command Prompt or PowerShell and run the following command:
git --version


macOS:

  • Homebrew (recommended):
  • If you have Homebrew installed on your macOS, open Terminal and run the following command:
brew install git
  • If Homebrew is not installed, you can install it first by following the instructions on the Homebrew website (https://brew.sh).
  • Verify the installation: To check if Git is installed correctly, open Terminal and run:
git --version

description:
Looking for Full-Time Web/Mobile App Designer


Contract Duration: 1 to 3 months (Full-time, with potential for extension based on performance)


Hours: 8 hours per day, 5 days a week


We are seeking a skilled Web/Mobile App Designer to join our dynamic team on a full-time contract basis. The ideal candidate will take over the responsibilities of our current designer and contribute to the design and enhancement of our web and mobile applications. You will play a critical role in shaping the user experience and visual appeal of our products, utilizing your expertise in Figma to bring our ideas to life.


Responsibilities:


Main Task #1 - Mobile App (Android / iOS) Product Design

Main Task #2 - Video Voting Contest Product (Module) Design.


1. Collaborate with the team to gather and evaluate user requirements

2. Illustrate design ideas through storyboards, process flows, user journey maps and sitemaps

3. Design graphic user interface elements, such as menus, tabs, and widgets

4. Develop page navigation buttons and search fields

5. Create UI mockups and prototypes to showcase functionality and appearance

6. Collaborate with key team members to ensure efficient planning and execution:

a. Work with our COO  to define all requirements.

b. Collaborate regularly with our devs so that they can convey all requirements and designs to the development team

7. Present rough drafts to internal teams and key stakeholders

8. Identify and troubleshoot UX problems, ensuring responsiveness

9. Conduct layout adjustments based on user feedback

10. Adhere to brand and style standards regarding fonts, colors, and images


Requirements and Skills:

1. Proven work experience as a UI/UX Designer or similar role

2. Portfolio showcasing design projects, particularly in web/mobile applications

3. Proficiency with wireframe tools (e.g., Wireframe.cc and InVision)

4. Up-to-date knowledge of design software such as Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop

5. Strong team spirit and excellent communication skills for effective collaboration

6. Good time-management skills to meet project deadlines

7. BSc in Design, Computer Science, or a relevant field

description:
1. Install Git: - 30 mins
  2. If you don't have Git installed on your computer, you can download it from the official website (https://git-scm.com/downloads). Follow the installation instructions for your operating system.
  3. Set up Git: - 20 mins
  4. After installation, you'll need to configure your Git username and email address. Open a terminal or command prompt and run the following commands, replacing "Your Name" and "your@email.com" with your actual name and email.
  5. Create a Git repository: - 20 mins
  6. A Git repository is a folder where you'll store your code and its version history. Navigate to your project's folder in the terminal and run:
  7. Learn Git basics: - 2 hours
  8. Familiarize yourself with basic Git commands, such as:
  9. git clone: Copy a remote repository to your local machine.
  10. git add: Add changes to the staging area.
  11. git commit: Create a commit with the changes you've added to the staging area.
  12. git status: View the current status of your repository.
  13. git log: View the commit history.
  14. git pull: Fetch and integrate changes from a remote repository.
  15. git push: Upload your local commits to a remote repository.
  16. Create a remote repository: - 30 mins
  17. If you want to collaborate with others or store your code on a platform like GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket, create a remote repository on the respective platform and follow their instructions to connect it to your local repository.
  18. Branching and Merging: - 1 hours
  19. Learn about branching to work on different features or fixes independently, and merging to integrate those changes back into the main branch.

description:
Windows:


  1. Download the installer: Go to the official Git website (https://git-scm.com/downloads) using your web browser.
  2. Select your download: Click on the "Windows" icon to download the installer for Windows.
  3. Run the installer: Once the download is complete, locate the downloaded file (usually named "Git-X.X.X-XXX.exe," where X.X.X-X is the version number) and double-click on it to start the installation process.
  4. Configure installation options:
  5. Select the components you want to install. The default selections are usually sufficient for most users.
  6. Choose the default text editor for Git (you can keep the default editor or choose your preferred one).
  7. Select the "Use Git from the Windows Command Prompt" option. This will enable you to use Git from the Command Prompt or PowerShell.
  8. Choose "Checkout Windows-style, commit Unix-style line endings" to ensure line endings compatibility across platforms.
  9. Choose the default branch name: Set your preferred default branch name. "master" is commonly used, but you can choose something else if you prefer.
  10. Choose the SSH executable: Unless you have specific requirements, it's generally fine to use the OpenSSH default.
  11. Complete the installation: Click "Install" to begin the installation process. Once it's completed, click "Next" and then "Finish" to exit the installer.
  12. Verify the installation: To check if Git is installed correctly, open a Command Prompt or PowerShell and run the following command:
git --version


macOS:

  • Homebrew (recommended):
  • If you have Homebrew installed on your macOS, open Terminal and run the following command:
brew install git
  • If Homebrew is not installed, you can install it first by following the instructions on the Homebrew website (https://brew.sh).
  • Verify the installation: To check if Git is installed correctly, open Terminal and run:
git --version

description:
1. Basics of MongoDB:

   - Understand data types, documents, and collections in MongoDB.

   - Learn about queries and operators, including aggregation for advanced data manipulations.

   - Practice CRUD operations to create, read, update, and delete documents.

2. Schema Design and Indexing:

   - Understand the importance of schemas and indexes in MongoDB.

   - Learn about schema design principles, embedding vs. referencing, and denormalization.

3. Set Up MongoDB Atlas:

   - Create a free MongoDB Atlas account and explore the interface.

4. Realm SDK:

    - Understand Realm SDK concepts such as Realm Object Model, Realm Data Types, and Realm Database Operations.

    - Explore Realm Sync for offline capabilities and data synchronization.

Project Implementation with Vue


1. Connect to MongoDB Atlas:

   - Integrate Realm in your project and connect to your MongoDB Atlas cluster.


2. Integrate MongoDB with Vue:

   - Display fetched data in Vue components and design user-friendly UIs.


3. Handle User Input:

   - Implement UI components and event handlers to allow users to interact with the application, such as adding new data or updating existing records.


Advanced Topics and Optimization


1. Optimization Techniques:

   - Optimize backend server and database queries for performance.

   - Implement caching mechanisms to reduce server load and improve response times.


2. Real-time Updates:

   - Explore techniques like WebSockets for enabling real-time updates between the Vue app and MongoDB.


3. Error Handling and Logging:

   - Implement error handling mechanisms on both frontend and backend to provide meaningful feedback to users.
